card.title: TRUK
card.text: TRUK atoll was the main Japanese naval base in the South Pacific during WWII.
card.flavorText: The atoll of Truk in the Caroline Islands was used as a Japanese forward naval base prior to the war and during WWII it became the main Japanese naval base in the South Pacific. A large portion of the Japanese fleet was based in Truk and it hosted five airfields, several seaplane and torpedo boat bases, repair facilities and a radar station. In February 1944 the Truk base was destroyed by the American airpower and was cut off for the remainder of the war.
